How local System-One models compare to TypeSafe's Jev when assisting in the Operating Room

By Tim Peko (TimerErTim)Last updated: Nov 12, 2026

Operating rooms have lots of knobs and levers to turn. Voice assistants are already common in smart homes, but reliable, real-time control is a different challenge in an operating room. I test JevK5-2B, an open-weight 2B model, running locally on my RTX 2080, and compare it with TypeSafe's Jev on a virtual operating room task. Jev is more accurate and faster in my tests, so this JevK5-2B setup doesn't yet look like a practical local alternative.
